Anchor: FanoutCapacity. Four requests can call handle simultaneously. Each request has eight independent blocking jobs; each job remains active until an external event. Review the capacity implication of this code:

def handle(jobs):
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
        futures = [executor.submit(process, job) for job in jobs]
        return [future.result() for future in futures]
